messages:
Maya: quick ping — noticed our SDK examples use `prompt_text` but the console/ui and most docs call it `input`. I opened a small PR to standardize to one param (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345). Thoughts on the canonical name?
Alex R: Thanks — saw the PR. +1 to picking something neutral like `user_input` so it reads well across text-gen, chat, and embeddings.
Devon: FWIW the JS SDK currently exports `prompt` in v0.9; Python uses `prompt_text`. If we pick `user_input` we should add migration notes and a snippet for both SDKs.
Samir: Agree `user_input` is fine. Can we also align the console labels (Settings -> Prompt) to say "User input / Prompt" for a migration window?
Jordan: I'd rather avoid long labels in the UI. Suggest we keep UI as "Prompt" but add a hover tooltip: "API param: user_input (formerly prompt_text/prompt)".
Maya: good compromise. I'll update the PR: rename examples to `user_input`, add a short migration section and a UI tooltip task.
Alex R: Suggest adding a glossary entry for "prompt vs. instruction vs. user input" so product writers know when to prefer each term. Small example sentence: "user_input — the raw text provided by the user (may be a prompt, instruction, or system message)."
Devon: I'll draft that glossary blurb and attach it to the PR. Also will prepare the SDK snippet changes. Example to include in docs: ```js
// before
client.generate({ prompt_text: 'Summarize this text' })

// after
client.generate({ user_input: 'Summarize this text' })
```
Samir: DocsBot, run link-check on the PR and add a note to the migration guide checklist. :pray:
DocsBot: CI started for PR #2345 — link-check, lint, snippet-tests. Status updates will post here.
Maya: thanks — once CI passes, let's merge and I'll create a short changelog entry and a one-paragraph note in the migration guide (v0.9 -> v1.0 param rename).
Jordan: can someone add an item to the release notes task list so PMs can review language?
Alex R: I'll add it to the release-notes board and add @product-review in the PR description.
Maya: great. Action items: Devon — glossary blurb + SDK snippets; Alex — release notes + PR description; Samir — UI tooltip work item; Jordan — keep label/simplification review. I'll follow up after CI. :thumbsup:
